title: Cross-Surface Color-Logic Independence
question: Can Kymaean exhibit a distinctive, accessible and product-compatible shared-brand color logic across both a restrained app-like utility context and an expressive public-web context when symbol/wordmark, bespoke typography, material/texture, imagery, Quiet-Stage composition, motion signature, product-state red/green semantics and historical palette incumbents are removed as identity carriers?
scope_interpretation: CLR-01 tests color-role relationships as an independent Phase-B identity mechanism. It does not select a final production palette, theme, semantic status colors, material system, Windows implementation, website theme or final identity.

external_accessibility_snapshot.usage_note: WCAG 2.2 is the web measurement reference. WCAG2ICT is transfer guidance for the app-like specimen only; CLR-01 does not claim native Windows accessibility certification.

floors.normal_text: 4.5:1 minimum against every field/surface on which it appears
floors.large_text: 3:1 minimum if any large-text exception is deliberately used; the frozen carrier is designed not to require this exception
floors.essential_ui_and_graphical_boundary: 3:1 minimum against adjacent field where required for identification
floors.focus_indicator: author-drawn focus ring must maintain at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors and remain visibly identifiable; keyboard focus may not be conveyed by hue alone
floors.use_of_color: no content, state, relationship, action or eligibility meaning may depend on color alone
floors.reflow: 320 CSS px equivalent without horizontal overflow from the specimen carrier

required: identical content, geometry, type sizes, weights, spacing and element order across families
all candidate labels exposed during Director + Design Sol review; no external blind-review claim
forbidden_identity_carriers: Threshold K or any symbol/app icon
gradients, glow, blur, shadow spectacle, translucency or texture
Mineral Theater or another historical palette/material incumbent
Quiet Stage, hero or relational-trace composition
F1A, CS2 or other scored motion
success/error/warning/loading colors or red/green status semantics
product-state claims whose meaning is carried by hue
isolation.historical_palette_quarantine: Candidate values are derived only from the role-logic experiment below. After freezing, compare them against historical palette/material records for accidental convergence. Do not alter a frozen family to imitate or avoid a remembered incumbent after results are visible.
isolation.forbidden_rescue: After specimen execution or subjective review begins, no family may receive a hue, chroma, lightness, role-allocation or surface-specific retune. Failure/zero-survivor is an allowed outcome.

blocks.text: A field holds several related parts.
Each part remains distinct while sharing one context.

geometry.WEB_WIDE: 1280x720 CSS reference frame; centered 720px neutral panel
geometry.APP_WIDE: 1024x720 CSS reference frame; centered 680px neutral panel
geometry.REFLOW_320: 320 CSS px frame; single-column panel; no content reorder
rules: one heading, one body paragraph, three equal structural rows and one button-like neutral action
no app chrome, navigation, cards with differentiated geometry, decorative shapes or illustrations
border thickness, radius and spacing are identical across all families/contexts

role_usage.primary: heading, primary body and primary-item text
role_usage.accent: one small non-semantic emphasis strip plus action border/focus ring and optional action fill; accent never denotes status
role_usage.soft_surface: non-semantic low-emphasis row background; primary/secondary text remains readable over it

context_adaptation.principle: Hue topology, role assignment and relative emphasis order are invariant. WEB may use a stronger field tint/accent chroma; APP uses the restrained values frozen per family. Context may not add/remove a hue family or move meaning to a different role.
context_adaptation.APP: restrained values listed in each family
context_adaptation.WEB: expressive values listed in each family
context_adaptation.REFLOW_320: same context colors as wide; only geometry reflows

CNEG.name: Neutral grayscale control
CNEG.purpose: Readable, accessible low-identity baseline with no chromatic mechanism.

CCONV.name: Conventional product-blue calibration control
CCONV.purpose: Accessible familiar digital-product color grammar used to calibrate generic-category resemblance; excluded from Kymaean-family selection.

F1.name: Split Temperature
F1.mechanism: Cool/dark structural ink is held against a quiet warm-earth accent; identity comes from a stable warm/cool hinge rather than chroma quantity.
F1.primary_risk: generic heritage/editorial warmth or premium-earth palette

F2.name: Monochrome + Intruder
F2.mechanism: Most roles stay inside a subdued violet-neutral ladder while one rare teal accent interrupts it; identity depends on scarcity and exception rather than broad multicolor contrast.
F2.primary_risk: generic creative-tool violet/teal or artificial rarity that feels decorative

F3.name: Complementary Poles
F3.mechanism: A restrained green-tinted field/ink system is counterweighted by a plum accent; neither pole encodes status and both remain subordinate to legibility.
F3.primary_risk: generic botanical/wellness signaling or accidental red/green semantic association

F4.name: Chromatic Ladder
F4.mechanism: A warm near-neutral field is crossed by a blue chromatic ladder distributed from soft surface through boundary to concentrated accent, testing identity through role-linked saturation rather than opposing hues.
F4.primary_risk: collapse into familiar blue-product/SaaS grammar despite warmer field structure

matrix.construction_rule: Generate exactly one deterministic specimen for every family/control × context × viewport tuple. No color, content, geometry or role change may occur after the packet is frozen.

required_before_subjective_review: 24/24 specimens materialized from this contract with exact declared hex values
normal primary and secondary text contrast >= 4.5:1 on field and soft_surface wherever used
accent used as text or essential control boundary >= 4.5:1 for text and >= 3:1 for required non-text identification against adjacent field
white text on any filled accent action >= 4.5:1
boundary role >= 3:1 against field where the boundary is required to identify the row/control
keyboard focus visible and not color-only
zero horizontal overflow at 320 CSS px
no meaning/state/action eligibility depends on hue alone
forced-colors/high-contrast sanity pass confirms content, structure and action remain comprehensible when candidate colors are suppressed
computed style/source audit confirms no gradient, filter, texture, image, box-shadow spectacle or animation identity carrier
historical-palette quarantine check performed only after candidate source freeze
preflight.failure_rule: Any scored family failing a hard accessibility/isolation floor is removed before subjective review. No retuning or replacement family is allowed after failure evidence is visible; zero-survivor is valid.

review.process: Direct Design Sol + Director adjudication; no external blind-review population is required and no blind-consensus claim may be made.
review.design_sol_order: Design Sol freezes an independent pre-Director view after mechanical preflight and before receiving Director preference.
tasks: cross-surface family coherence: does APP/WEB read as one color logic rather than unrelated palettes?
distinctiveness: does the family carry recognizable character beyond accessible color polish?
genericity: does it collapse into an obvious category convention represented by CCONV or another familiar visual trope?
calm/low-fatigue compatibility: can the color logic coexist with the already-selected restrained motion principles without visual agitation?
semantic honesty: does color imply status, priority, success/failure, identity or authority that the neutral fixture does not possess?
fallback resilience: does the carrier remain understandable with color suppressed?
possible_outcomes: one or more provisional color-logic survivors
bounded follow-up on a surviving mechanism without production palette authority
review.prohibited_outcome: No CLR-01 adjudication alone may declare a final Kymaean palette or Phase-C identity family.

non_authority: All hex values are experiment fixtures only, not production color tokens.
No dark/light theme decision is made; this experiment intentionally uses one light-luminance carrier to avoid theme-mode confounding.
No Windows high-contrast/native accessibility certification is claimed.
No semantic status-color system, website theme, app theme or material system is selected.
No image generation, renderer spend, app/site implementation, motion retune, Stage motion, final identity or Phase-C convergence is authorized.
